verifier: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$m=Get-Content -Raw manifest.sha256.json | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach($i in $m){ if((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $i.path).Hash -ne $i.sha256){ throw "hash mismatch: $($i.path)" } }; $p=Get-Content -Raw SEALED.proof.artifact | ConvertFrom-Json; if(-not $p.sealed){ throw "proof not sealed" }; Write-Output "VERIFIED""
